entries.content: BACKLOG #29 (Nels Workshop Hub) promoted from backlog to active change on 2026-09-11 (T-705). Unblocked because business-os workstreams B (portfolio foundation) and C (environment tiering) have landed. The hub is a separate repo (nels-workshop-hub), uses Granary UI components, v1 is read + light-actions. Scope decisions: no invoicing/contracts for v1, not a source of truth, writes go through existing scripts. Build as mission #1 through the pipeline — dogfooding the wireframe gate.
